Name: Skip Start
Author: DeadRobotDev
Description:
[size=3]This mod allows you to fish, mine, and enter the Community Center on Spring 1, Year 1.

Specifically, the mod:
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Skips the "Introductions" and "To The Beach" quest.[/size]
[*][size=3]Adds a "Bamboo Pole" to your inventory if you haven't already met Willy.[/size]
[*][size=3]Opens the Community Center.[/size]
[*][size=3]Removes the landslide.[/size]
[/list][size=3]
[/size][size=5]Install
[/size][list=1]
[*][size=3][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].[/size]
[*][size=3]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].[/size]
[*][size=3]Run the game using SMAPI.[/size]
[/list][size=3]
[/size][size=5]Configuration[/size][size=3]
[code] "IntroductionQuestSkip": true,
"Willy": "skip",
"MineOpen": true
"CommunityCenter": "lewis",
[/code]
[b]IntroductionQuestSkip[/b]
[/size][list]
[*][size=3][b]true[/b] - Default. Completes the Introduction Quest.[/size]
[/list][size=3]
[b]NOTE:[/b] Enabling this skips the quest, not the dialogue. The villagers will still introduce themselves.

[b]Willy[/b]
[/size][list]
[*][size=3][b]""[/b] - No changes.[/size]
[*][size=3][b]"day1"[/b] - Allows you to visit Willy on Day 1.[/size]
[*][size=3][b]"skip"[/b] - Default. You start with the Bamboo Pole.[/size]
[/list][size=3]
[b]MineOpen[/b]
[/size][list]
[*][size=3][b]true[/b] - Default. Removes the landslide on Day 1.[/size]
[/list][size=3]
[b]CommunityCenter[/b]
[/size][list]
[*][size=3][b]""[/b] - No changes.[/size]
[*][size=3][b]"open"[/b] - Default. Skips the Mayor Lewis event. The Community Center is open.[/size]
[*][size=3][b]"wizard"[/b] - Skips the Mayor Lewis AND Wizard events. The Community Center is open, and you can donate items.[/size]
[/list][size=3]
[/size][size=5]Compatibility
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Works with Stardew Valley 1.5 or later on Linux/macOS/Windows.[/size]
[*][size=3]Works in single player, multiplayer, and split-screen mode.[/size]
[/list][size=3]
[/size][size=5]See Also
[/size][list]
[*][size=3][url=https://github.com/DeadRobotDev/StardewMods]Source code.[/url]﻿﻿[/size]
[/list][size=3]
[/size][size=3]
[/size]
